LanguageData.SSC_CorruptionGel.label: depravity gel
LanguageData.SSC_CorruptionGel.description: A gel carrying fragments of experience rather than a complete personality. Ingesting it induces a lingering euphoria and slight distraction. Another dose refreshes the duration without strengthening the effect. SSC masters are immune. While the effect is active, each confirmed orgasm adds 2 percentage points of corruption, up to 10 additional points per encounter, subject to the current stage limit.
